get_valid_finger_types: get all supported finger type names from the trifinger simulation module
check_finger_type: check if a given finger type name is valid and raise ValueError if not
get_finger_urdf: get the URDF file path for a specified finger type like trifingerpro
get_number_of_fingers: get the number of fingers for a specified finger type such as trifingeredu
get_initial_joint_positions: get the initial joint positions for a specified finger type like fingerpro
